note: This file IS the scope. relocate-pool-rows-by-list.cjs REPOINTs exactly these ids and nothing else.
rulings: CF-A-FINISH-IS-A-CARD-LINE (Drew 2026-09-07): a Pokemon finish (Holofoil / Reverse Holofoil / Normal / Cosmos Holo / Cracked Ice) is its own card line, minted only from a checklist/attested source.

#1937 (MERGED) folded five market spellings onto two canonical slug tokens: holofoil and reverse-holofoil. #1938 (DEPLOY VERIFIED prod=0f9321b, 2026-09-07) reached the fix into parseTitleIdentity via pokemonFinishFromTitle.ts, so every sale ingested since that deploy already resolves to the canonical spelling.

These 3,047 rows were ingested BEFORE #1938 landed and carry a stale hobbyiqCardId at the pre-fold spelling (e.g. reverse-holo) even though a checklist-backed catalog row already exists at the canonical token (reverse-holofoil) for the same (setKey, cardNumber). This is a stored-row backlog, not a live derivation defect -- confirmed live: parsing the SAME stored titles through the current pokemonFinishFromTitle.ts already answers the canonical display name.

cardId (the sold_comps partition key) is a vendor id (CardHedge numeric id / eBay item id), never the hobbyiqCardId -- every entry here is a REPOINT (hobbyiqCardId patched in place), never a RELOCATE (no partition move).

Each repointHobbyiqCardId target was verified live against card_catalog immediately before this list was written: the row exists and its source matches /checklist|tcgdex|pokemon-tcg-data|scraped|finish-attested/i (a real checklist/attested source, never ingest-auto-seed).

Source sample: the 2026-09-19 sales-volume ranking pull (150,000 rows, 2026-08-20..2026-09-19, unordered cross-partition fan-out -- see S/rank-queue/queue-2026-09-19.md for the pull methodology and its known skew). This list covers every non-canonical-finish-spelling candidate FOUND IN THAT SAMPLE for the six named setKeys; it is not a full-pool sweep and a broader Cosmos query would likely surface more rows for the same six sets and others.
By setKey in this list: sv03-5 782, sv10 536, sv08 507, me01 440, sv09 373, me03 409 (total 3,047).
